name: go-consistent-hash
title: Go consistent-hash cache cluster
blurb: Three in-process cache nodes behind a consistent-hash ring with virtual nodes, replication and ring-order failover, all stdlib.
default_description: A sharded cache where adding or removing a node moves only its own share of keys.

verify.name: selftest
verify.cmd: mkdir -p build && go build -o build/{{ npm_name }} . && ./build/{{ npm_name }} --selftest

verify.name: smoke
verify.cmd: mkdir -p build && go build -o build/{{ npm_name }} . && bash smoke.sh
